work_scope.capability: Optional wake and mail metadata display
work_scope.required_evidence: Mounted regression before/after, existing full panel suite, scoped compiler
work_scope.explicit_non_goals: No wake dispatch, pairing, program action, provider invocation, terminal claim or mail schema changes

review: A wake with a deck but no optional packetIds previously crashed while computing deck colors. The display now uses the existing wake-request fallback when no packet ID is present.
An omitted mail analysisState previously crashed label formatting. Missing analysis/freshness now display unknown; absent confidence retains the warning tone without pretending a numeric value.
The evidence-reference sorter declares the optional strings it already receives and explicitly narrows its existing truthy filter; sorting and empty-value exclusion remain unchanged.

Two mounted regressions use the existing panel harness and assert no non-GET requests. The corrected baseline failed at the packet-index and label-formatting sites. An initial fixture accidentally used items instead of mailItems; its partial result is retained but not used as evidence for both defects.
Both source and suite matched public preview before this slice. Only these reviewed changes are newly qualified; other existing Stage Play contract errors remain open.

Adding the existing suite to the reviewed compiler roots exposed seven pre-existing fixture diagnostics. The pointer helper now uses the testing-library target type, five dot-all expressions use equivalent ES2017-compatible character classes, and the environment fixture uses its actual observation_not_assistant_answer context role. Original assertions and production authority are preserved.

The existing environment identity fixture now supplies the full current LiveAnswerEnvironment contract: line schema, lines, subgoals, summary and compact-context/raw-data flags replace obsolete line_keys, active_lines and token_budget fields. Query identity assertions are unchanged. Both intermediate compiler receipts are retained.
limits: Unfrozen, unpublished, uninstalled source qualification. Mocked queries prove panel behavior, not authenticated room membership or game/GPT Live delivery.
The fixture exercises optional fields, not arbitrary malformed nested data. Model/provider and program actions remain outside this check.
